newsitem.title: USA: Iowa unemployment hits record low 3 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Iowa unemployment hits record low 3 pct in May.

text.p: Iowa's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate fell from 3.3 percent in April to a record low 3.0 percent in May, Workforce Development Department reported Thursday.
The unemployment rate was down from 3.7 percent in May 1996 and the lowest since Iowa began recording seasonally adjusted data in 1978, the department reported.
The actual number of unemployed Iowans also dropped to a new low of 48,700 in May, compared to 53,600 in April, the department reported.
Job gains were posted in services, retail trade, government, durable goods, manufacturing and finance, the department said.
The largest decline in May occurred in construction where employment fell 500, but the the sector remained 4,400 higher than it was in May 1996, the department said.
